description_en: Queries whether the current user is a delegated administrator of WAF in the multi-account management feature
description_zh: 多账号统一管理中，查询用户是否是WAF的委派管理员
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-account-delegated-status --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccountDelegatedStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

AccountName.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account name. This parameter is returned only when the account is a delegated administrator
AccountName.description_zh: 阿里云账号名称，当账号为委派管理员时返回该信息

DelegatedStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the user is a delegated administrator of WAF. Valid values:

true: The user is a delegated administrator of WAF.

false: The user is not a delegated administrator of WAF
DelegatedStatus.description_zh:
是否是WAF的委派管理员。

true：表示WAF的委派管理员。

false：表示非WAF的委派管理员
